newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL PALM OIL ENDS MOSTLY DOWN, SEEN MIXED.
newsitem.headline: KL PALM OIL ENDS MOSTLY DOWN, SEEN MIXED.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS
Oct (3rd pos) 1,235 rgt/tonne Aug (south) 1,275 *
Open/Hi/Low 1,240/1,244/1,226 Prev close 1,275
Prev settlement 1,240 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices fell after a steady opening, on profit-taking and the ringgit's rebound against the dollar. Trading was volatile and market awaits USDA report tonight. Near-term trend is seen mixed. Oct's support seen at 1,230 with resistance at 1,250.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Prices rebounded on some refiners' covering and sentiment followed the futures sector.
"With the ringgit recovering some ground during the day, prices fell back on profit-taking. People felt that the market was overdone," the trader said.
"People are unsure of the immediate trend due to the wild swings of the ringgit although there was some hedge buying activity," he said.
The market had opened steady after the ringgit fell to a new 42-month low of 2.79 early on Tuesday. The ringgit rebounded to around 2.7645 at 1000 GMT.
Traders also said uncertainty over the weather in U.S. soy crop areas was keeping buyers here cautious.
At the close, the October futures contract was five ringgit down at 1,235 ringgit ($446.73) a tonne.
Support for the contract is seen at 1,225 and resistance at 1,250.
Physicals Aug (south) offered at 1,275 ringgit against bids of 1,270 after trading at 1,265 and 1,270.
Aug (central) was also offered at 1,265 against 1,250 with trades done at 1,255.
Sep (south) saw offers at 1,275 ringgit against bids of 1,270 after trading at 1,270.
Sep (central) was offered at 1,265 against 1,260 with trades done at 1,255 and 1,260.
In refined palm oil, Sep RBD palm oil was offered at $487.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, and Oct/Nov/Dec at $485.
Aug RBD palm olein saw offers at $530, Sep at $525 and Oct/Nov/Dec at $522.50. Sep was traded at $522.50.
Sep RBD palm stearin was offered at $360 and Oct/Nov/Dec also at $360.
Sep/Oct RBD palm fatty acid distillate saw offers at $285.
